opener.text: Create FINAL PRODUCTION print artwork ready to print directly. All specs below are INSTRUCTIONS to follow, never text to display. Show no dimension markers, px/mm labels, wireframe boxes, or annotation text.
You are producing finished, print-ready artwork. Every instruction is a directive, not text to render. Do not draw any measurement labels, guides, or notes.

hero_after_desc.text: AFTER area shows a RAZOR-STRAIGHT geometric result, dense uniform vibrant green, no dead brown patches, wide establishing shot showing the full scope of work.
AFTER area shows a clean, freshly finished result in vibrant healthy green, uniform and tidy, full work visible end to end.

hero_before_desc.text: BEFORE area shows a WILD IRREGULAR overgrown state with multiple dead brown patches, bumpy uneven growth, slightly desaturated.
BEFORE area shows a neglected overgrown state, brown and unkempt, slightly desaturated, same framing as the after.

diagonal.text: Exactly ONE diagonal cut at 42-45 degrees running bottom-left to top-right, with a thin #3FA34D green line along its edge. Never a second diagonal.

cta_block.text: CTA panel: green gradient #3FA34D to #2d8840 spanning full width. Small caps 'ZAVOLEJTE', then '730 588 372' huge white Montserrat extra-bold, then 'SeknuTo.cz' below.
CTA panel: solid dark forest #1e5a32. Small caps 'ZAVOLEJTE', then '730 588 372' huge white heavy sans, then 'SeknuTo.cz' in yellow #FFD54F below.
